data.name: Fur Fun
data.detailed_description:
Fur Fun



A multiplayer 3D platformer FUN Game!

Welcome to Fur Fun!

Fur Fun is For Fun... Get it?

Game is Ready! Will be published when approved on Greenlight!


This is a multiplayer 3D platform game where you can play up to 4 friends.
The main goal is to explore this 3d world where you can collect coins to unlock new levels.

There are a lot of crazy physics that you will love playing around, with an implemented ragdoll system to make it more fun.
In each level you will have some minigames to play with your friends, like football, or dodging giant rocks!

Also, you will have to cooperate, because each character has its own abilities and attack modes.
Or being a certain height to access other places!

Also, at the end of each level you will see a boss that you will have to defeat in order to get to the next
level with your friends! Or you can just hack the game if you're into that. I don't judge.

Right now we have 2 different characters with different skins, but we're planning to add more in the future!

Also we're going to be updating the game constantly, because this is only an early access, new characters, new minigames and new game modes, so stay tuned for updates and let's do it Fur Fun! HOOOHHMYGODIMSOFUNNY THESE JOKES HFMFG

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows 7/8/10 64bits
  • Processador: Quad Intel Core i5 or AMD 2,5 Ghz or faster
  • Memória: 4 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460, Intel HD Graphics 4600 or GPU compatible with DX11 equivalent
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 10 GB de espaço livre
  • Notas adicionais: If you don't have the min. reqs, the game will crash in the lobby
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recomendados:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows 7/8/10 64bits
  • Processador: Quad Intel Core i5 or AMD 2,8 Ghz or faster
  • Memória: 8 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: Nvidia GTX 660, AMD Radeon HD 7870 or GPU compatible with DX11 equivalent
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Rede: Ligação à Internet de banda larga
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 10 GB de espaço livre
  • Notas adicionais: If you don't have the min. reqs, the game will crash in the lobby

reviews.review:
Why does this game keep getting delisted and relisted? Guess the guy got money via direct deposit to his card and still forgets that Steamwork's is charging him the $100? Idk anyways I played this trash and I'll tell you my thoughts:
Pros:
* Bright Colors make brain go brrr
* The amount of bugs is kinda funny
Cons:
* Said bugs make it virtually impossible sometimes
* Some enemy's are annoying to deal with in batches
* Parkour, which seems to be a main component, is bugged
* That bird won't shut up, he thinks he's smart mocking me for my bad parkour when it's already buggy WHEN HE CAN JUST FLY... OH WAIT IN THE BETA YOU WERE A PLAYABLE CHARACTER WHAT HAPPENED TO THAT? (also what happened to the meercat? He's just dead)

All in all, do not buy this game. If you are looking to play it (don't know why), there's a "Free to Play" package on SteamDB just go there.
